propositions: The session-start field-readiness gate waits for Epic Link and Epic Name before any project is created, but GreenHopper only provisions these fields when the first Jira Software project is created, creating an ordering deadlock independent of timeout budget.

All 62 harness cells error at fixture setup with identical 27-field inventory (zero customfield entries) after 600s and after 1800s budgets, proving the defect is not timing but a blocked prerequisite action.
Run 30964805133 (pre-1406) passed 62/62 on the same image because no gate blocked project creation, allowing fields to be provisioned; this proves the image and plugin are functional.

The decision rule in not_ready_message incorrectly interprets an empty custom-field inventory as plugin-still-starting, when it is the normal state of a Jira instance with no project, misdiagnosing the true ordering bug as a budget shortfall.
The probe (jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py) contains the same ordering bug—it calls _await_named_fields before project creation at line 156-168—and has never passed since change 1387.

The field-readiness check must move from session setup to after project provisioning in _assert_project_capabilities; the 15s capability confirmation budget must be raised because its premise (readiness budget already satisfied at session start) is now false.
